title: no calibration effect
symptom: BG checks are constantly 15-20mg/dl higher than xDrip readings, with false hypos and false non-hypers. Calibrations do not seem to change this fact.
fix: Reduce the number of calibrations; calibrate only when BG is near horizontal line in high and low values, maximum 2-3 calibrations a day.
evidence_quote: Wow! It's too much calibrations! Do it when BG is near horizontal line in high values and in low and all will be ok. We do maximum 2-3 calibrations a day.
